summary: Visually, this reads as a plausible large utility/fighting knife: thin blade, restrained guard, full-tang construction, compact grip and functional lanyard eye. Its 0.4425 m overall length, 0.118 m grip scales and 0.027 m thickness are credible and correctly separate the object from the 1.3 m gameplay reach; the named root, grip/tip markers and separate constructed parts are useful. However, the renders do not support the README’s material claims: blade, bevel, guard and supposedly charcoal rubber grip all appear nearly identical pale grey, making the handle look like unpainted plastic or metal. Revise the exported materials so the grip is visibly dark, matte rubber; fittings/tang read as black oxide; and the blade and cutting bevel have restrained but legible steel-value/roughness separation under neutral lighting. Keep the current simple geometry, though slightly soften the grip-scale contour if needed to improve hand comfort without swelling it. Correct the README to record that the present render failed material-separation validation and remove any implication that the four named materials already read successfully until the revised GLB renders prove it.
